contract_name: Phase 89/91 scene fusion to existing DepthWizard viewer

coordinate_policy.projected_coordinates: source CRS coordinates, normally UTM meters for Indian scenes
coordinate_policy.viewer_coordinates: local meter coordinates derived from projected coordinates minus scene origin; x=easting, z=northing/image-row convention documented by adapter, y=elevation
coordinate_policy.origin: explicit projected coordinate of raster pixel (0,0) or chosen scene origin

elevation.coordinate_system: source projected CRS / local viewer meters
elevation.meaning: real DEM elevation; nodata remains invalid

x.coordinate_system: source projected CRS or local viewer meters

y.coordinate_system: source projected CRS or local viewer meters; viewer vertical axis is separate

terrain_fields.nodata_policy: exclude invalid terrain faces; never convert DEM nodata to zero

footprint.coordinate_system: source raster CRS and derived viewer local coordinates

height.null_policy: null when unavailable; never zero-fill or interpolate

base_elevation.coordinate_system: terrain CRS vertical datum as supplied by DEM

height_available.meaning: true only when a finite Phase 89 prediction is mapped to this component ID

viewer_compatibility_fields.height_available: new required field for unavailable-height inspector/UI handling

serialization.current_boundary: Python geometry dict serialized into generated HTML JSON
serialization.recommended: validate JSON-safe nulls before serialization; reject NaN/Inf; include CRS, transform, bounds, and provenance metadata
